fichas.title: Indoor and Outdoor Pools: Foil Linings and Construction Details
fichas.summary: Construction guidance for foil-lined indoor and outdoor swimming pools. Foil linings can avoid the usual waterproof sub-structure. Embossed, structured foil is recommended around stairs, standing steps, and children's paddling pools for safety. Details illustrate bonded sheet metal edges, fixed flange connections, drainage and relief provisions, prefabricated pools, and rounded floor-to-sidewall connections.
uses: Provide safe, slip-resistant surfaces in areas where users stand or walk
Connect and seal foil at edges and penetrations

fichas.title: Indoor Pool Evaporation and Climate
fichas.summary: A table relates indoor-pool evaporation to relative air humidity and air temperature, distinguishing out-of-operation conditions (R) from maximum-use conditions (M). An accompanying chart marks evaporation limits for a pool in use and out of operation. The printed table values are not transcribed because their cell associations are not reliably legible.

fichas.title: Pool Edge Overflow Channels and Surface Skimmer
fichas.summary: Illustrated pool-edge and water-handling details include named overflow systems, a Finnish channel, a precast concrete gutter with foil liner, and a surface skimmer. Several details identify grip tile, slip-resistant paving, gratings, expansion joints, drainage channels, and ring drains.
uses: Collect and drain overflowing pool water
Provide pool-edge access and slip-resistant paving
